name: autouml
description: Visualizador y editor de diagramas UML desde proyectos Java
author: INGSOFT

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,electron "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.node.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 file:dist-electron/infrastructure/main/main.js file:dist-electron/infrastructure/preload/preload.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
